---
title: "New research project launched: SBO FireRisk"
date: "2026-10-01"
description: "Integrated Wildfire Risk Assessment and Response in the Region of Flanders"
---

The new SBO FireRisk project (Integrated Wildfire Risk Assessment and Response in the Region of Flanders) officially started on 1 October 2026! UHasselt (Centre for Environmental Sciences (CMK) and Digital Future Lab (DFL)) serves as project leader alongside a strong consortium of academic and institutional partners.

Partners: UHasselt (CMK & DFL - lead), PXL, UAntwerpen, KU Leuven, and INBO.
